title: Dolorès (new opera)
doubts: IDENTIFIED (inference, strong): Salvatore Auteri-Manzocchi, Dolores (Florence, Pergola, 23 Feb 1875), written for the soprano Isabella Galletti-Gianoli; Rome Teatro Apollo carnival-Lent 1875-76. "Gaietti" = Galletti. Exact Rome première date not confirmed. 087.0833 Dolorès is Audiffret's step-sister, unrelated. Alias kept to the quoted form only. No free score/libretto found.
